title: She's blushing over her manga. He refuses to even look
caption:
When your favorite manga is a two-person activity
She giggles and blushes over her comic, then pushes it toward Luo Chen - and he crosses his arms, looks away, and swears he doesn't read that stuff.
Everyone knows that feeling: something makes you laugh and you NEED someone else to see it.
Are you the "look at this!" friend or the "not reading that" friend?
Follow for more tiny animated drama moments.
